title: veronica dissecta subsp. lanuginosa
intro: Veronica dissecta subsp. lanuginosa, commonly known as Woolly Speedwell, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm the skin, reducing redness and irritation. The bioactive constituents of Woolly Speedwell, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. Furthermore, the plant's antioxidant properties may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being.
